items.title: The Nutcracker Theatre Sign
items.alt: Ornate navy theatre sign reading The Nutcracker, with copper trim, red tassels and a wooden toy at one side.
items.description: Cream lettering fills the navy sign beneath a copper fan-shaped crest. Red tassels hang below, and a small red-jacketed nutcracker stands on the shared wooden base.

items.title: Nutcracker Cabinet with Six Drawers
items.alt: Crowned nutcracker cabinet with six cream drawers, green shoes and a red ribbon in one open drawer.
items.description: Six small cream drawers fill the broad toy's jacket front. One lower drawer opens around a red ribbon, beneath a dark painted face, curled black hair and burgundy crown.

items.title: Carving a Nutcracker Outline
items.alt: Black-and-white drawing of a curly-haired woodcarver shaping a nutcracker at a complete workbench.
items.description: A curly-haired maker steadies the tall toy in a bench cradle while working near its boot. Curled shavings, chisels and a mallet spread across the sturdy wooden bench.

items.title: Family Reading a Nutcracker Programme Outline
items.alt: Outline of a girl with two braids showing a nutcracker programme to two adults seated beside her.
items.description: The girl holds a folded programme with a small nutcracker drawing on its cover. A bearded man and headscarf-wearing woman lean closer from separate wooden chairs.

items.title: Hands Using a Nutcracker Outline
items.alt: Black-and-white close-up of two hands cracking a walnut above a bowl of kernels and folded tea towel.
items.description: Two hands close the tool's handles around a walnut held between the jaws. A shallow bowl of kernels, folded checked towel and two whole walnuts sit beneath the action.

items.title: Making a Nutcracker Card Outline
items.alt: Curly-haired boy in a striped apron attaching a paper nutcracker to a folded card at a craft table.
items.description: The boy steadies an upright card while working on its paper nutcracker decoration. Loose paper shapes and a small glue container remain on the table beside his hands.
